author: nemi
text: Right, the noticeboard. The sensible new sign says assembly, and the old one says pudding. Before you say anything, I can see that it's crossed out. I'm choosing to interpret that as decorative. Six gets us to assembly; five lets us investigate the pudding. You can probably guess which one I'm hoping for.
